title: GMV Max
content_data:
GMV Max is an automated ad campaign type that optimizes total channel ROI for your TikTok Shop. 

To learn about how to create such campaigns, see [Create GMV Max Campaigns](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1822009058467842).

This group consists of the following endpoints:

**Campaign**
- [Get GMV Max Campaigns](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1826463372290177)
- [Get the details of a GMV Max Campaign](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1822000968821762)
- [Create a GMV Max Campaign](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1822000988713089)
- [Update a GMV Max Campaign](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1822001009002497)
- [Get the recommended GMV Max ROI target and budget](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1822001024720897)
- [Create a max delivery or creative boost session](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1835246967275522)
- [Update a max delivery or creative boost session](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1835247009119233)
- [Get max delivery or creative boost sessions within a campaign](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1835246996436162)
- [Get details of max delivery or creative boost sessions](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1835247031331842)
- [Delete a max delivery or creative boost session](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1835246983475217)
- [Remove or add back creatives in a GMV Max Campaign](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1861260625563202)

**TikTok Shop and products**
- [Get TikTok Shops for GMV Max Campaigns](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1822001044479041)
- [Get products within a TikTok Shop](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1793482248880130)
- [Check the availability of a TikTok Shop for Product GMV Max Campaigns](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1822001084174338)

**Identities and posts**
- [Get identities for GMV Max Campaigns](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1822001101474882)
- [Check the occupancy of identities or products in Shopping Ads](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1822001136924674)
- [Get posts for a Product GMV Max Campaign](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1822001168512129)
- [Get details of videos in customized posts](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1830215925061633)
- [Create shop-level customized TikTok posts](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-shop-level-customized-tiktok-posts/v1.3)
- [Get customized TikTok posts](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-customized-tiktok-posts/v1.3)
- [Delete customized TikTok posts](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/delete-customized-tiktok-posts/v1.3)
- [Get product linkage details of videos in customized posts](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-product-linkage-details-of-videos-in-customized-posts/v1.3)

**Ad account exclusive authorization**
- [Get the TikTok Shop exclusive authorization status of an ad account](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1822001184635905)
- [Grant an ad account exclusive authorization for a TikTok Shop](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1822001200356354)

**Reporting**
- [Run a GMV Max Campaign report](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1824721673497601)
	- [Metrics in GMV Max Campaign reports](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1824722485971009)
